features: Implement a fix for request management backend scripts and frontend modal with table components
Establish application theme and initial component architecture with layout, data tables
Minor fixes for the UI, request signatories, modal layout overhaul.
Updated system to fully support globally unique 26-character string ULIDs instead of integer IDs
Fixed audit trail ID wrapping by preventing nowrap in the UI table
Fixed audit trail saving by updating database schema and ULID length
Added migration script to automatically backfill states for existing older properties
Fixed an issue where missing table columns for locations prevented options from loading on fresh installs
Fixed backend fatal errors that caused 'Network issue' when saving properties and CORS issues during deletion.
Implemented automatic bidirectional auto-cancellation logic: regardless of entry order, superseded properties automatically switch to CANCELLED state.
Fixed table creation for property states and settings on strict MySQL environments.
Added support for Notification Bell and Changelog.
Fixed ETRACS property table local synchronization to show correct properties.
Fixed Local Property states so that they accurately reflect CURRENT and CANCELLED pills based on their superseded status.
Support for creating, reading, updating and deleting local properties.
